concrete_scene.heading: Worked trace: the polished patch that lost the correct first answer
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A fixed three-candidate maintenance deliberator and correlated self-verifier evaluating a database migration
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Decide whether a legacy column can be deleted after the first candidate correctly notices an old rollback dependency and later candidates omit it.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The self-verifier selects the polished but wrong consensus, an independent repository check restores the missing dependency, and execution remains blocked with an owned residual.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The trace tests whether more candidates and self-scoring monotonically improve correctness; a correlated verifier can turn an initially correct answer into a wrong final choice.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: Planning retains the bounded recommendation while the migration owner must update the rollback script or retain the column; Runtime receives no execution authority.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The chapter also reports a real authored held-out run where fixed deliberation scored 11/32 and direct or adaptive routes scored 12/32; that result rejects usefulness on this corpus, not all test-time compute.

worked_trace.heading: Worked trace: the polished patch that lost the correct first answer
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The held-out authored corpus rejects useful gain from the tested extra-compute and stopping policies while preserving corruption accounting; it does not refute every deliberation method, verifier, model, or task.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: Direct generation is the strongest simpler baseline and matched adaptive stopping at 12/32 while beating fixed deliberation's 11/32; more compute must earn admission after corruption, verification, and total cost.
readable_claim: The contribution is not a superior search algorithm. It is the transaction boundary around any such algorithm: a policy may allocate computation and emit candidates, but its own score cannot settle their truth or authority.
normative_rule: The system may branch, revise, compare, or stop. It must keep the cost, rejected candidates, verifier limits, and residual questions visible.

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The trace binds its concrete failure to the tested policy and authored corpus and distinguishes corruption from failure to repair.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Candidate, verifier, stopping, trace-faithfulness, difficulty, task, model, resource, safety, and transfer limits remain in their dedicated evidence sections.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The narrative trace and four-arm result remain because candidate-history corruption is the argument; detailed raw candidate and scorer records stay in experiment artifacts.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The readable transaction-boundary statement and short rule lead into the retained exact inference-lease claim.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The tested-corpus ceiling is preserved because it prevents a local negative result from becoming a universal refutation.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: The result table and candidate trace are argument-bearing; raw bookkeeping remains in the experiment directory.

non_claims: The result does not refute every test-time compute or deliberation strategy.
The trace does not establish verifier truth, planning correctness, or execution authority.
The editorial packet does not move support or release state.
